text: The dashboard puts one repository at a time in focus, as @gitdek asked while watching it. Choosing a repository scopes the whole page to it, the headline, the status rows, the orbit, the numbers, the models and the fleet included, and everything from the other repositories fades out, then fades back in when everything is shown again. With everything shown, another repository's items are quieter than Invariant's own and come after them. The public page's Needs you also points the owner to `/act`, where a retry posts with a button instead of a copied command.
